nodes.name: Acknowledge Immediately
nodes.notes: Meta requires a 200 within a few seconds or it retries/disables the webhook. Ack first, then keep processing in the background execution.

nodes.name: Has Inbound Message?
nodes.notes: Meta also sends 'statuses' webhook events (delivered/read receipts) on the same path. Only proceed for actual inbound messages, ignore status callbacks.

nodes.name: Extract Message Fields
nodes.notes: messageType is one of 'text', 'image', 'audio' (voice notes arrive as type 'audio' with voice=true inside the audio object, same media/id shape). mediaId is populated for image or audio messages, empty for text. Sticker, video, and document messages are not handled here yet, same 'unsupported type' fallback below covers them.

parameters.query:
SELECT c.id, c.business_name, c.industry, wn.id AS whatsapp_number_id
FROM customers c
JOIN customer_whatsapp_numbers wn ON wn.customer_id = c.id
WHERE wn.whatsapp_number = $1

nodes.name: Load Customer by Number
nodes.notes: phone_number_id from Meta's payload must match a row in customer_whatsapp_numbers.whatsapp_number exactly. A customer can have more than one number, this join finds the owning customer regardless of which of their numbers received the message. whatsapp_number_id (added 2026-08-12, requires supabase/migrations/004_conversation_number_attribution.sql) is this specific number's own row id, used below to attribute the conversation to it, not just to the customer as a whole.

nodes.name: Customer Found?
nodes.notes: If no customer row matches this WhatsApp number, stop. Don't guess or default to some other customer's data.

nodes.name: Is Image or Voice Note?
nodes.notes: Text messages skip straight to the existing pipeline unchanged. Image and audio messages route through the download-and-transcribe/describe branch below before rejoining at Get or Create Conversation.

nodes.name: Is Text?
nodes.notes: Reached only when Is Image or Voice Note? found no mediaId, meaning the message is either plain text or an unsupported type this workflow doesn't handle at all (video, document, sticker, location, contact card, etc., added 2026-08-12). True branch is the existing text path. False branch escalates to a human instead of silently dropping the message the way it did before this check existed.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO conversations (customer_id, contact_name, contact_phone, whatsapp_number_id)
VALUES ($1::uuid, $2, $3, $4::uuid)
ON CONFLICT (customer_id, contact_phone) DO UPDATE
SET whatsapp_number_id = EXCLUDED.whatsapp_number_id
RETURNING id;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ $('Load Customer by Number').item.json.id }},{{ $('Extract Message Fields').item.json.contactName }},{{ $('Extract Message Fields').item.json.fromNumber }},{{ $('Load Customer by Number').item.json.whatsapp_number_id }}

nodes.name: Get or Create Conversation (Escalation)
nodes.notes: Same find-or-create query as 'Get or Create Conversation' on the normal path, duplicated as its own node rather than shared, because n8n connections are per-node: sharing one node between both branches would also merge their downstream routing (this branch must not flow into Log Inbound Message / AI Agent Reply). Both nodes independently converge on the same underlying conversations row (same customer_id + contact_phone), so no duplicate conversation is created.

parameters.query:
UPDATE conversations
SET needs_human = true,
    escalation_reason = $2
WHERE id = $1::uuid

nodes.name: Flag Conversation: Needs Human
nodes.notes: Requires supabase/migrations/003_conversation_escalation.sql to be applied first (adds conversations.needs_human, conversations.escalation_reason). No business-owner notification is sent here, confirmed with the user 2026-08-12 as explicitly out of scope for this pass: the dashboard's future conversation list is the only place this flag surfaces today, per DASHBOARD_UI.md.

VALUES ($1::uuid, 'inbound', $2)

options.queryReplacement: ={{ $('Get or Create Conversation (Escalation)').item.json.id }},{{ '[' + $('Extract Message Fields').item.json.messageType + ' message, not yet supported]' }}

nodes.name: Log Unsupported Inbound Message
nodes.notes: Logs a placeholder body so the conversation thread shows something arrived, instead of a gap. The real content (a video/document/etc.) is never transcribed or described, unlike the image/voice note path above, this type genuinely isn't handled yet.

nodes.name: Send Escalation Reply
nodes.notes: Fixed, non-AI-generated reply, deliberately not routed through the AI Agent since there's nothing for it to reason about (no text, no describable media). Matches the /whatsapp-agent page's existing promise: 'It flags the chat with the full conversation. You take over, and the customer never feels ignored.'

nodes.name: Log Escalation Reply
nodes.notes: Same outbound-logging pattern as Log Outbound Message at the end of the normal AI reply path, kept as a separate node since this branch never reaches AI Agent Reply's output to reuse that node's query.

nodes.name: Get Media URL
nodes.notes: Returns { url, mime_type, sha256, file_size, id }. The url is Meta's lookaside CDN and expires 5 minutes after this call, download it immediately in the next node, don't store or delay on this URL.

nodes.name: Download Media Binary
nodes.notes: Same bearer token as Get Media URL, Meta's CDN checks auth on this request too, it's not a plain pre-signed URL. Output is binary data (this node's response format is 'file'), consumed by whichever of the two nodes below matches the message type.

nodes.name: Image or Audio?
nodes.notes: Splits the downloaded binary to the vision-description path (image) or the transcription path (audio/voice note).

parameters.text: =Describe what's in this photo in one or two plain sentences, focused on anything relevant to a customer inquiry: product, item, damage, quantity, or written text visible in the image. This description will stand in for the customer's message, so be concrete and specific, not vague.

nodes.name: Describe Image (GPT-4o Vision)
nodes.notes: Turns the photo into a text description, which Set Media As Message Text below treats exactly like a typed message. If the customer also sent a caption with the image, that's appended too (see mediaCaption field), so 'here's the shoe I want, do you have size 42?' isn't lost.

nodes.name: Transcribe Voice Note (Whisper)
nodes.notes: WhatsApp voice notes are Opus-encoded .ogg files, Whisper accepts this format directly, no transcoding step needed.

assignments.name: messageText
assignments.value: ={{ $('Extract Message Fields').item.json.messageType === 'image' ? ($json.content || $json.text || '') + ($('Extract Message Fields').item.json.mediaCaption ? ' Caption from customer: ' + $('Extract Message Fields').item.json.mediaCaption : '') : ($json.text || $json.content || '') }}

nodes.name: Resolve Message Text (Media)
nodes.notes: Overwrites messageText with the image description or voice transcript. Feeds into Merge Message Text below, which is the single node downstream code actually references by name, since only one of this node or 'Resolve Message Text (Text)' runs on a given execution.

nodes.name: Resolve Message Text (Text)
nodes.notes: Plain-text messages skip the media pipeline but still pass through a same-shaped node, so both branches can feed the same Merge node below.

nodes.name: Merge Message Text
nodes.notes: FIXED 2026-08-23: was a Merge node (chooseBranch/input1) that always returned the Media branch and silently dropped every text message. Replaced with isExecuted checks, same pattern as kb-ingest's Merge Content Sources.

Reuses the existing thread instead of creating a new one per message. whatsapp_number_id (requires supabase/migrations/004_conversation_number_attribution.sql) is refreshed on every message, so it always reflects whichever of the customer's numbers most recently received a message from this contact, not just the number active when the thread first started.

nodes.name: Log Inbound Message
nodes.notes: Reads messageText from Merge Message Text, the single node both the text and media branches converge through, so this logs the typed text for text messages and the image description / voice transcript for media messages, whichever branch produced this item.

nodes.name: AI Agent Reply
nodes.notes:
REVAMPED 2026-08-23: industry-aware (Diagnostics Mode vs Sales Mode via customers.industry), sales mechanics gated to non-medical verticals, expanded ecommerce/real-estate/retail edge cases from Nigerian market research, symptom-triage boundary added alongside the existing results-interpretation one. 

KNOWN, ACCEPTED LIMITATION: this workflow has no conversation memory node. Every message is a stateless execution. Instructions in this prompt that assume multi-turn context (clarifying questions, order collection across messages, not repeating a follow-up question) work only within a single message's reasoning, not across separate WhatsApp messages. This is a known gap, not an oversight -- fixing it is a real infrastructure task (a memory node keyed to conversation_id), deliberately not done here. Ecommerce order-taking specifically depends on this more than any other vertical, since placing an order is inherently multi-step.

Not built yet, out of scope for this logging-focused pass.

nodes.name: Check Live Sheet
nodes.notes: REBUILT 2026-08-23: was a flat full-sheet dump, now a real search tool. Reads the header row live on every call instead of assuming fixed column names, so it works regardless of how the customer's sheet is structured. Fails gracefully -- errors return a clean sentence, never a crash or a hallucinated answer. Still points at CONNECT_YOUR_SHEET_ID (single test sheet) until per-customer connections exist -- swap the credential auth call for a per-customer token lookup when that's built.

FROM vertical_templates vt
LEFT JOIN customer_agent_config cac ON cac.customer_id = $2::uuid
WHERE vt.industry = $1
